methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve camera tripods spanning studio and travel categories: four Manfrotto models, two Peak Design models, one Gitzo, one Joby, one Benro, one Vanguard, one Sirui, one K&F Concept, and one Neewer. Specs independently re-verified 2026-06-19 against manufacturer product pages (manfrotto.com, gitzo.com, benrousa.com, peakdesign.com, joby.com, store.sirui.com, neewer.com) and major retailers (B&H, Adorama, precision-camera.com, KEH). Prices are published US MSRP or consistent current retail. head_included is true when a head ships in the box at the stated price; release refers to the leg lock mechanism (flip_lock = lever/cam, twist_lock). Corrections applied this pass: Joby source URL fixed (had pointed to the 5K Video PRO instead of the 5K Kit); Neewer TP08 max height corrected 79.5->77 in (79.5 was the monopod config) and price 69.99->59.99 per neewer.com; Vanguard 263AT price set null (no single verifiable published USD price; sources span $149.99-$299.99) and weight corrected 4->4.3 lb. All other entries verified accurate. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Manfrotto 055 Aluminum 3-Section Tripod with Horizontal Column
products.provenance: Specs verified from official Manfrotto global page: max height 170 cm/66.93 in, closed 61 cm/24.02 in, weight 2.5 kg/5.51 lb, safety payload 20 kg/44.09 lb, 3-section, Flip Lock. Price $229.95 corroborated at procam (regular price). Head not included at this price.

products.name: Manfrotto 190 Aluminum 4-Section Tripod with Horizontal Column
products.provenance: Specs confirmed: max height 63 in, folded 19.2 in, weight 4.6 lb, load 15.4 lb, 4 sections, Quick Power Lock levers (flip/lever type). $199.95 per precision-camera (stand-alone tripod). Head not included.

products.name: Manfrotto Befree Advanced Travel Aluminum Tripod with 494 Ball Head
products.provenance: Specs verified from official Manfrotto page: max height 151 cm/59.45 in, closed 40 cm/15.75 in, weight 1.59 kg/3.51 lb, safety payload 9 kg/19.84 lb, 4 sections with Flip Lock (lever) locks, includes Advanced 494 center ball head. MSRP $259.95 per authorized US dealers including B&H.

products.name: Peak Design Travel Tripod — Aluminum
products.provenance: Specs verified: max 60 in, folded 15.5 in (official figure), weight 3.4 lb, load 20 lb, 5-section aluminum cam (flip) locks, integrated Compact Ball Head included. Official Peak Design / precision-camera / B&H all list $399.95 (the $379.95 seen at some 3rd-party sellers is a sale price).

products.name: Peak Design Travel Tripod — Carbon Fiber
products.provenance: Specs verified: max 60 in, folded 15.5 in, weight 2.8 lb, 20 lb load, 5-section carbon fiber cam (flip) locks, ball head included, price $599.95 (official Peak Design / B&H).

products.name: Joby GorillaPod 5K Kit
products.provenance: CORRECTED source URL — draft pointed to the GorillaPod 5K Video PRO (JB01561), a different product; the 5K Kit is JB91508 (verified official Joby page). GorillaPod uses flexible ball-and-socket joints, so leg_sections and release are null; folded length not a standard metric for this form factor. Head height 15.2 in / 38.5 cm, load 11 lb / 5 kg, kit weight 739 g / ~1.6 lb (incl. BallHead 5K). MSRP $179.95 consistent across retailers. Released 2017.

products.name: Benro Mach3 Series 3 Long Aluminum Tripod 3-Section Twist Lock
products.provenance: All specs verified from Benro USA and B&H: max height 179 cm/70.47 in, folded 68 cm/26.8 in, weight 2.36 kg/5.2 lb, load 16 kg/35.3 lb, 3-section aluminum twist locks, no head, price $199.95. Release year ~2015 (Amazon listings + availability by 2016); moderate confidence on exact year (low-risk field).

products.name: Vanguard Alta Pro 2+ 263AT Aluminum Tripod
products.priceNote: Legs only (no head). No single verifiable published US price; retail spans $149.99-$299.99 across dealers.
products.provenance: Specs verified at B&H/als.com: max 64 in, folded 24.6 in, weight 4.3 lb (corrected from 4 lb), load 15.4 lb/7 kg, 3-section legs with 35-degree twist locks, no head. priceUsd set null: no single verifiable published USD price — als.com list $299.99/sale $149.99, other sources cite $179.99 and $219.99. products.name: Gitzo Mountaineer Series 2 4-Section Carbon Fiber Tripod
products.provenance: Verified exactly against official Gitzo page: max height 165.5 cm/65.16 in, closed 56 cm/22.05 in, weight 1.68 kg/3.7 lb, safety payload 22 kg/48.5 lb, 4-section Carbon eXact legs with G-Lock Ultra twist locks, head not included. products.provenance: Max height 1200 mm/47.2 in, load 6 kg/13.2 lb, 5-section carbon legs with twist locks, B-00K ball head included. Total weight ~0.73 kg tripod + 0.2 kg head ~= 2.0 lb. MSRP $199.90 — established across retailers incl. camerasolutionsinc ($199.99); the $116/$129 currently on Sirui's own store is a temporary sale.
